newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY FORINT FIRMS VS BASKET, EASES VS DLR.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY FORINT FIRMS VS BASKET, EASES VS DLR.

text.p: 1020 GMT - Hungary's forint firmed against the central bank's currency basket, returning to its accustomed position close to the resistance level (NBH bid) as fears of a zloty-inspired weakness subsided, dealers said.

* The Hungarian unit ended the morning session just two or three pips from the NBH bid after opening 25/30 pips weaker and was slightly softer against a strengthening dollar at 192.50/55, compared to a 192.45/50 opening.
* Dealers said concerns that the forint would be affected by the falling Polish zloty had disappeared and trading was now back to normal.

* The Hungarian unit left the NBH bid on July 16 due to the Polish zloty's weakness but dealers said the forint would eventually close the gap as Hungary's fundamentals did not warrant a weakening of its currency.
